The durable base is the **reserve inventory**: 112 MMboe total-company 1P at Dec 31, 2025 [Estimate, company Jan 2026 reserves release], of which **Canada is ~39% of 1P (~44 MMboe)** [Estimate]. Plus the **Dawson Clearwater / Mount Head** report: ~6.5 MMbbl 2C contingent + ~55 MMbbl P50 at Dawson Clearwater + ~12 MMbbl at Mount Head ≈ **67 MMbbl unrisked prospective**, "a focus of our drilling activity in 2027" [Actual, P1]. This is *prospective/contingent* (not proved) → treated as **optionality**, not a contracted annuity, and only partially credited in Base.
3. **Strategic optionality:** (a) the ~$315M post-close cash (buyback / reinvest in Dawson–Mount Head); (b) Azerbaijan exposure referenced in P4; (c) Tisquirama contract conditions satisfied (Colombia — but that asset is sold).
